description: This file defines a front-end component named 'Home' using LightningJS framework. It orchestrates the layout consisting of a header, a notes list, and an editor pane, along with handling theme, user interactions, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: $handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection events from NotesList component, updating the internal 'selected' state.

methods.name: $handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation events from NotesList component, setting the newly created note as selected.
